claims.text: Therefore, governments should establish comprehensive AI regulation frameworks to ensure responsible development and deployment.

premises.text: Major technology companies are investing billions of dollars in AI research and development.
Machine learning algorithms now outperform humans in many specialized tasks, from image recognition to strategic game playing.
Artificial intelligence is rapidly transforming our society and economy.
The European Union's AI Act provides a good model for risk-based regulation.
Studies show that proactive regulation can prevent harmful outcomes while still fostering innovation.
However, tech industry leaders argue that premature regulation could stifle innovation and harm economic competitiveness.

assumptions.text: National sovereignty should limit global technology governance
Representative institutions can effectively govern emerging technologies
